study.question: Does a moderate, source-initialized reduction of item capacity to12 or14 preserve the stronger source click AUC while reducing persistent parameters AND measured prediction cost, with context/action capacity held at16? Observation: source AUC0.660646940486458, parameters32060453. Coupled item8/action16 reaches0.6599120831369636 with19868541 parameters and p50/p95 9.9076/9.9586ms versus coupled full16 11.6654/11.7116ms; its AUC deficit0.0007348573494944 fails retention. The uncoupled same-shape item8 trial reached0.651350616000785, showing a consequential initialization association. Earlier native_context16_item12 reached0.6588889130763208 but reduced ACTION to12 too, so it is not an item-only control. These are same-seed local observations, not independent confirmations.
study.hypothesis: Some of the item8 loss may come from removing too much item representation capacity rather than a requirement for all16 coordinates. Retaining the first12 or14 source-initialized coordinates in every item table and corresponding semantic dense input blocks, while retaining action/context16, may recover click quality with lower storage and runtime. Initial coordinates are drawn from an untrained full16 CPU reference, not a checkpoint or teacher. At width12 an uncoupled native initializer distinguishes capacity dose from initialization replacement. The round15 2x2 results associate action-width and initialization effects with quality, but do not establish the mechanism or monotonic capacity response. Predeclared exploratory advancement rule: click AUC no more than 0.0002 below the matched full16 control, at least 8% fewer persistent parameters, and at least 3% lower model-only p50 and p95 batch latency, with no more than 3% increase in loader-inclusive inference seconds. Report continuous quality/cost results even when this rule fails. A single seed or a validation threshold does not establish statistical noninferiority or robust retention. If several cells qualify, advance the smallest; otherwise retain the source and report the observed frontier. Before claiming retention, seek three paired host-authorized seeds and a paired user-cluster interval for the AUC difference whose lower bound exceeds -0.0002; multiplicity and validation selection remain limitations. No seed override is submitted in architecture config.

study.proposed_difference: Item-only graded width12/14, context/action16, plus same-shape native12 initialization replacement and full16 compatibility/timing control. Each module is standalone. Both initializer modes construct the same untrained full16 CPU reference, then construct the native model in a CPU RNG fork reset to the incoming state; only coupled mode copies source embeddings, semantic scorer/tower input columns, shared hidden parameters and all buffers. Ending CPU RNG follows one full16 construction, with no reseeding/device RNG calls. No historical/source checkpoint, data-dependent coordinate selection, learned expansion or new runtime feature. Expected counts, inferred from same-layout item8/full16 receipts: width12 25964497 (19.01% less), width14 29012475 (9.51% less), full16 32060453. These counts and cost reductions are predictions until host measured.
predictions: Full16 control reproduces the source parameters, initialized state, forward operator, CPU RNG endpoint and same-seed validation metrics. A mismatch blocks attribution rather than counting as a scientific null.

Coupled12 and/or coupled14 recover some of the coupled8 click deficit under fixed exposure; a nonmonotonic result is possible and must be retained. Neither intermediate width is presumed to meet the advancement rule.

At identical native12 architecture and persistent parameter count, coupled12 may outperform native12 if initialization replacement matters; this contrast alone cannot identify whether shared random coordinates, dense fan-in scaling or nonlinear optimization explains the difference.

Intermediate widths reduce table storage and semantic first-layer input dimensions. Actual p50/p95 latency, loader-inclusive throughput, train time and peak memory may fail to improve because kernel shape and loading dominate. Measure rather than infer speed from parameter count.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values and auxiliary mean separately, plus pre-existing history slices with sample/positive/negative counts. Do not describe click retention as retention of all-task performance.
falsifiers: Both coupled intermediate cells remain more than0.0002 below the full16 click control: the local preservation prediction fails within this tested coordinate family, even if quality improves over item8.
Any qualifying click/storage cell fails the measured latency/throughput criteria: the joint efficiency benefit is unsupported for that configuration.
Native12 matches or beats coupled12: this run does not support a coupling advantage at width12, even if an item-capacity frontier improves.
Unchanged full16 mismatch, unexpected registered scratch tensors, altered sample order, tensor-copy or mask failures invalidate causal attribution and must be logged as implementation failures.
alternative_explanations: One shared seed, repeated use of validation, and many earlier adaptive trials can produce a favorable point by chance; endpoint replays are not independent random initializations or replication.

Copying full16 first-layer weights changes variance relative to native12 Xavier initialization; width contrasts also change activation statistics and optimization conditioning. The initialization control bundles these effects and is not a proof of redundancy.
Deleting a coordinate prefix is one arbitrary capacity restriction; negative results do not refute all lower-dimensional representations or learned reallocations.

Prior evidence spans half-embedding/dense reductions, projected/copy controls, context/item reallocation, identifier/attribute reallocation and action-width cells. Lower AUC or weak measured speedups in those branches are scientific negative findings, not execution failures. Available trajectory statuses are successful and previous_runtime_error is null; no failed execution is invented.

Frozen offline feedback visibility, inherited whole-window vocabulary/static snapshots, one-pass training and small auxiliary label prevalence limit transfer. No production causal-validity claim follows.

CPU reference construction consumes memory/time and copying creates preparation overhead; both modes pay the same reference allocation but different copy cost. Model-only latency excludes that overhead and loader-inclusive inference is reported separately.

The historical ordinary-width and coupled-width trials need not have left the same post-construction CPU RNG stream; a changed host sampler stream could contribute to their association. The new same-shape control explicitly aligns both incoming and ending CPU RNG states, and the host must verify actual sample order before attributing differences to initialization.
